notes_for_extractor: Strikethrough redlines are the dominant hazard: deleted sets, deleted headers and individual deleted rows are present in the text layer, so a text-only extractor will emit duplicate/obsolete sets unless it detects strike-through line graphics (or the gold set must define how to treat them). Set ids are renamed mid-document (old id struck, new id beneath), and qty 'As Req' plus '---'/'TBD' placeholders in finish/mfr need handling.
